messages.subject: WES data ...
parts:
Hello ,

           I would like to know can the CODEX pipeline be used for whole exome data or separately for 1 chrmosome at a time and how can we do that?.

Regards,
GARIMA

messages.author: 94ec915e8ce36448
messages.subject: Re: WES data ...
parts:
Hi Garima,

Yes CODEX processes the entire genome chromosome by chromosome — this is needed to make the computation more efficiently and to segment each chromosome into CNV regions.

Hope this clarifies,
Yuchao

parts:
Hi Garima,

That script (CODEX_IGV.R) is initially for our internal visualization use only and is not part of the CODEX package. With this said, you need to modify the script to your own run/analysis. Have you modified the code?

Also you need to send me the entire running results with R output. I cannot tell what’s wrong with only one error. If you want me to help you further, you can use save.image(file=‘codex_igv_diagnostic.rda’) and send the file to me.

Yuchao
